handlebars.description: Handlebars extends Mustache with helpers, partials, and block expressions. Templates are pre-compiled to JavaScript functions, which gives it a strong advantage in repeated-render scenarios.
features: Partials and partial blocks for layout reuse

mustache.description: The original logic-less template language. Zero conditionals or loops in the traditional sense — sections double as both truthiness checks and iterators. Available in 40+ languages.
features: Truly logic-less: no arbitrary JS in templates
{{#section}} acts as both if and each
mustache.perfNote: Minimal overhead, great for simple templates

pug.description: Pug (formerly Jade) uses indentation instead of closing tags and allows inline JavaScript. Its compile step produces a JS function — but the indentation parser adds overhead on first use.
pug.perfNote: Compile step is more expensive than Handlebars

ejs.description: Embedded JavaScript — standard HTML with <% %> scriptlets. The shortest learning curve for anyone familiar with PHP or JSP. Full Node.js runtime available inside templates.
